connection_condition: The county code is the leading component of the CDS code, and the district code is embedded in the same identifier, so a district record always sits inside one county.
description: A county is composed of the districts located in it; a district cannot exist outside a county.

connection_condition: Each school registry row carries a district name that identifies its administering agency, and the district name is repeated on every FRPM row of the school.
description: A district is composed of the schools it administers; a school record is always attached to one district.

connection_condition: The city is read from the city component of the school location address on the same registry row.
description: A school is located in a city, and the city groups schools for geographic counting. The city is reached through the school's own address rather than through an identifier reference.

connection_condition: The registry stores the code as 14 zero-padded characters while the SAT file stores the same code without the leading zero for county codes below 10; text comparison matches 2058 of 2269 SAT records, whereas numeric comparison or zero-padding to 14 digits matches all 2269.
description: The two identifier columns denote the same school or district despite their different textual representation.

connection_condition: Both columns live on the same registry row, and some categories appear under both vocabularies: the state special schools carry EdOpsCode 'SSS' and SOC code 31.
description: Two overlapping school classifications coexisting on one record; a school category may be named by one taxonomy, the other, or both, so neither is a complete substitute for the other.

connection_condition: Administrator names and e-mail addresses are stored on the school registry row itself, in up to three parallel slots, rather than in a separate person table.
description: A school is managed by one or more administrators recorded on its own registry record.

connection_condition: Numerator and denominator are carried on the same FRPM row under matching population labels.
description: Eligible free rate is derived as the free-meal eligible count divided by the enrollment count of the same population; the stored precomputed column already implements this ratio.

connection_condition: Numerator and denominator are carried on the same FRPM row under matching population labels.
description: Eligible FRPM rate is derived as the free-or-reduced-price eligible count divided by the enrollment count of the same population.

connection_condition: Both measures are carried on the same SAT record and refer to the same reporting unit.
description: Excellence rate is derived as the count of test takers scoring at or above 1500 divided by the total test taker count; no column stores this ratio, and the quotient is undefined when the test taker count is zero.

connection_condition: Both measures are reported side by side on the same FRPM row under the same population label.
description: The free-or-reduced-price eligible population contains the free-meal eligible population and additionally counts students eligible on the reduced-price scale; the reduced-price-only share is not stored separately.

connection_condition: Both are columns of the same FRPM row, so a school's meal counts are read together with the provision under which it claims them.
description: The provision status describes how a school claims reimbursable meals and therefore frames how its meal counts should be interpreted, without being a component of those counts.
